title: Weekly Visit Frequency Counted Across an Authorization Gap — Insured Plan of Care
content:
For a retroactive request on an Insured Plan of Care, the weekly visit frequency counted across the gap is the plan's own:

- where the plan funds an **active** Appointment Series, it is that series' visits per week;
- where it funds no active series but a **booked** one, it is the booked series' visits per week;
- otherwise it is the payer program's weekly visit maximum.

| Payer program | Weekly visit maximum (used only where the plan funds no active or booked Appointment Series) |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | 3 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | 3 |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | 3 |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | 3 |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | 3 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | 3 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | 2 |

**Hypothetical illustrations.** A Commercial POS plan funding an active Appointment Series booked at 2 visits per week uses 2. A Medicaid Managed Care plan whose only series is booked (not yet active) at 1 visit per week uses 1. A Medicare Advantage plan funding no active or booked series uses 3. Over 14 counted days, a frequency of 2 comes to 2 times 14 divided by 7, that is 4 visits.
